variants.prompt: In the intimate glow of candlelight, the woman reclines on a plush, velvet chaise in a lavish boudoir, her raven locks spilling across the crimson silk sheets. She wears a leather bodysuit that hugs her figure like a second skin, the sleek, black material molded to her every curve and valley. The choker adorning her neck catches the flickering candlelight, drawing attention to the cabochon opal centerpiece.
